desc: Build an adjacency list representation of the graph where each edge stores the target node and the XOR weight $Z_i$.

Implement a traversal (DFS or BFS) to identify connected components, compute relative offsets $C_u$ for each node, and verify cycle consistency (XOR sum of any cycle is 0). If inconsistent, return -1.
For each connected component, collect all nodes and their offsets $C_u$.

For each component, determine the optimal root value $K$ by iterating over each bit position (0-29). Count the number of nodes in the component with the current bit set in $C_u$. Choose the bit for $K$ that minimizes the total set bits in the resulting $A_u = C_u \oplus K$.
Compute the final values $A_u = C_u \oplus K_{\text{component}}$ for all nodes.
